author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell Brand sits down with Joe Kent to cut through the most weaponized silencing tactic in modern political debate. Joe Kent argues that the moment someone calls you antisemitic in a discussion about Israel's war and its influence over American foreign policy you can be certain you are winning the argument because they have nothing left to say. He makes clear this is not about Jewish people or religion but specifically about the Likud party, Benjamin Netanyahu and one political faction in Israel that has used the justified anger of October 7th to run amok in ways that are not even in Israel's own long term interest. Russell adds that any foreign government having this level of influence over American domestic and foreign policy is the real issue regardless of which country it is and regardless of what religion its people follow.

author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell Brand reacts to the deeply disturbing revelation that the UK government is now officially labelling cultural nationalism as a terrorist ideology, teaching that concern about western culture being threatened by mass migration is equivalent to extremism. Russell draws the parallel to how the British government once labelled the entire Irish nationalist movement as terrorism, a designation that led to innocent people being falsely imprisoned and an entire legitimate cause being criminalized. He argues that when a government starts using the word terrorism to describe the concerns of its own ordinary people about migration, food security, cultural identity and the decimation of Christianity, what you are witnessing is a government that has declared war on its own population.

description:
Keir Starmer claims he would never have appointed Peter Mandelson as ambassador had he known the true extent of his connection to Jeffrey Epstein and child trafficking. Russell Brand isn't buying a single word of it. As Director of Public Prosecutions for five years Keir Starmer ran one of the most powerful legal offices in the United Kingdom and now expects the British public to believe he had no idea what Epstein and Mandelson's relationship actually involved. Russell tears apart the excuse with his trademark precision and makes clear that either Keir Starmer is deeply incompetent or he is lying and neither option is acceptable for a sitting Prime Minister.

author: Russell Brand
description: Russell Brand reacts to Pete Hegseth announcing the militarization of the US border and immediately cuts through the tribal noise to ask the question that nobody wants to answer. If you support military force being used at the border under Trump would you support the exact same power being used under a president whose values you oppose? Russell argues that we must stop evaluating political actions based on who is carrying them out and start evaluating them based on the principle being established because every power you cheer for today will eventually be wielded by someone you didn't vote for.
title: This is bigger than Trump and always has been...
